note: The owners registry: for a statement that lives in more than one place, which carrier is authoritative and how every other mention relates to it. Named claims until 2026-08-09, when the reconciliation against docs/registries.md moved it out of docs/docs.json (a registry does not live inside another registry's carrier) and off a word the estate already spends three other ways. Rows are keyed by subject and typed by kind: a statement row owns one repeated statement; a family row is a DECLARATION in the registries.md sense, binding a scope to the carrier that owns a property across it, and carries applies_to. The nested repetitions stay nested: registries.md licenses a committed carrier to be a denormalized join, and this shape is the one the diff and the browser read best. Gated by tools/test/owners-registry.test.mjs.
scope: Statements the hub's own coordination layer repeats: the portable set, the conventions text, skills, adoption, toss routes, showing mechanisms, measured environment facts, and the code layers. NOT the content documents, whose one-owner question is the docs census's. The denominator is docs/ plus the skills, which is why eleven rows is a population and not a sample.
